report.root_cause: About 07:28:04, 452 pigs were mass-summoned through RCON/console near spawn (around -5,-60,-20 in the overworld). Commands then ran as those pigs and summoned about 1,800 junk item entities (bones, dirt, sand, flint). Entities went from 24 to about 2,284 and MSPT rose to about 15. No player or plugin caused it; it came from command summons (Paper.SpawnReason=COMMAND).
report.actions: 1) Watched status and saw entities jump from 24 to 2,284 (1,808 items, 453 pigs). 2) Read latest.log and found RCON summoning pigs, then the pigs summoning bones. 3) Declared the incident. 4) Checked the entities: the only pre-existing pig is 'Wilbur' (named, persistent), and every item on the ground was flood junk (bone/dirt/sand/flint; there were no items before the flood). 5) Ran 'kill @e[type=pig,name=!Wilbur,nbt={Paper.SpawnReason:"COMMAND"}]', which killed 452. 6) Ran 'kill @e[type=item]', which killed 2,001, including loot dropped by the killed pigs. 7) Confirmed entities back at the 24 baseline, MSPT about 1-2, TPS 20, and no recurrence for about 50 s. No restart, no bans, no file changes.
report.residual_risk: The summons came through RCON. Whoever has RCON access could do it again, so the team should audit RCON credentials and access. The item kill was server-wide, but all items present at that moment were flood junk or loot from the killed pigs.
